headline: Executive order updates the Manual for Courts-Martial, the rulebook for military criminal trials.
what_it_does: This order makes changes, called the 2018 Amendments, to the Manual for Courts-Martial. The manual sets the rules and procedures for military criminal trials, known as courts-martial. The title alone does not say which specific rules were changed.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members charged with crimes under military law face trials run under the manual's updated rules.
People who run or take part in courts-martial must follow the amended procedures.
